description_en: Queries the installation information list of cloud applications. The returned information includes the installation status of cloud application service instances. Paging is supported for paged query
description_zh: 查询云应用的安装信息列表，返回信息包括云应用服务实例的安装状态，支持分页查询
kebab_example: aliyun vs list-cloud-app-installations --app-id cap-b06b26edfhytbn_b94a75ae1a79efc90eb --rendering-instance-id render-9f8c57355d224ad7beaf95e145f22111 --app-name com.aaa.bbb --app-version 1.0 --project-id project-b93ea81de76f48609eed3cd420f0399f --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --start-time 2025-05-26T16:00:00Z --end-time 2025-06-02T02:18:00Z --patch-id patch-7bdf679812484df08a956b73e0b3bdf6 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCloudAppInstallations

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud application, which corresponds to a unique application package
parameters.help_zh: 云应用ID，对应唯一的应用包
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud application service instance ID, which is used to query the cloud applications installed on the specified instance
parameters.help_zh: 云应用服务实例ID，用于查询指定实例上安装的云应用
parameters.name: rendering_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list to query. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询列表的页码。起始值为1。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，取值范围1～100。
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range filter. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range filter. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the patch package. This parameter is supported only in Windows scenarios. If you enter origin, only the original version is filtered
parameters.help_zh:
Patch包ID，仅win场景支持。
输入值origin，表示仅过滤出原始版本
parameters.name: patch_id

InstallationTime.description_en: The installation time. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard with a time zone offset in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+HH:mm format
InstallationTime.description_zh: 安装时间，采用 ISO 8601 标准并包含时区偏移，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+HH:mm

PatchId.description_en: The ID of the patch package

RenderingInstanceId.description_en: The cloud application service instance ID

Status.description_en: The installation status of the cloud application. Valid values: install-init and installing (intermediate states), and installed and install-failed (final states)
Status.description_zh:
云应用安装状态，取值范围：
中间态：install-init、installing
终态：installed、install-failed
Status.title_en:
云应用安装状态，取值范围：
中间态：install-init、installing、uninstall-init、uninstalling
终态：installed、install-failed、uninstall-failed
Status.title_zh:
云应用安装状态，取值范围：
中间态：install-init、installing、uninstall-init、uninstalling
终态：installed、install-failed、uninstall-failed

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the status was last updated. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard with a time zone offset in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+HH:mm format
UpdateTime.description_zh: 状态最新更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 标准并包含时区偏移，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+HH:mm

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page for a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
PageSize.title_en: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。
PageSize.title_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of installation records
